name: sampler
title: Flexure sampler: seven flexures at three thicknesses, on two rails
orientation: Flat on the bed as drawn: every flexure bends in the plane of the bed, within its layers. 100% infill or walls enough to be solid (the thinnest flexures are two lines), 0.2 mm layers. Print one in PLA and one in PETG.

height.rule: Every flexure's width, up from the bed: 40 layers

rail.rule: The rail the flexures stand off, along y

spacing.rule: From one flexure to the next along a rail

hook.rule: The eye at a leaf's tip, to hang a weight or push with the gauge: outer size

eye.rule: The eye's hole, for a loop of thread

row.rule: From the front rail to the back rail, along y

eye_in.rule: How far the eye overlaps a leaf's tip, so they join

guide_length.rule: The parallel guide's leaves: shorter than the leaf springs

arms.rule: A notch hinge's arms, either side of the neck

post.rule: The posts that carry the bistable beam's ends off the rail

hinge_arms.rule: A living hinge's blocks either side of the strip
